findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: revclamp_stage_stripe_dispute_ce3 · Private data: revclamp_verify_webhook_signature · Public sink: revclamp_stage_stripe_dispute_ce3, revclamp_verify_webhook_signature, revclamp_simulate_webhook_replay · Destructive: revclamp_audit_revenue_leakage, revclamp_simulate_webhook_replay.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: revclamp_stage_stripe_dispute_ce3 · Private data: revclamp_verify_webhook_signature · Public sink: revclamp_stage_stripe_dispute_ce3, revclamp_verify_webhook_signature, revclamp_simulate_webhook_replay · Destructive: revclamp_audit_revenue_leakage, revclamp_simulate_webhook_replay

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
